name: sandcastle-kit
description: Shared Sandcastle setup: one base image, one orchestrator, per-project config.

scripts.test: bash test/in-temp.sh bash -c 'export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && bash test/status.test.sh && node --import ./test/no-stray.ts --test --test-timeout=300000 test/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:shard: bash test/in-temp.sh bash -c 'export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && files=$(node test/shard.ts) && node --import ./test/no-stray.ts --test --test-timeout=300000 $files'
scripts.test:weights: bash test/in-temp.sh bash -c 'export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && node --import ./test/no-stray.ts --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=300000 --test-reporter=./test/weights-reporter.ts test/*.test.ts'
